description: The menu, drinks or spa treatments of a venue with the prices of the website (EUR), as published on as_of; prices may change. price null: the website shows no price for that item. lang_served: the language in which the page shows its menu, when it differs from the requested one. API v3.

lang.description: Language of names, texts and links: de or en (default en).

section.description: Only one section: an id of the menu sections of the venue.

venue.description: Venue id, e.g. restaurant-ophelia, bar-c, wellness-harmony.

name: get_menu
title: Menu or treatment list
